source.author: Pellegrino Artusi
source.title: La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene (Firenze: Tipi di Salvadore Landi)
source.place: No. 280, Passato di patate, printed page 198; lines 18200-18224 of the text file

bicchiere.read: Same book, No. 443 (printed page 330): 'un bicchiere ossia 3 decilitri d'acqua'; and No. 451 (printed page 335): 'un bicchiere da tavola che corrisponde a decilitri 3 circa'. Both read in the page images; 1 dl = 100 ml (SI).

amount.original: Latte buono, o panna, mezzo bicchiere

note.en: Good milk; cream serves as well.
note.de: Gute Milch; Sahne eignet sich ebenso.

sourceNote.en: The book gives the size of its glass in two other recipes: 'un bicchiere ossia 3 decilitri' (No. 443) and 'un bicchiere da tavola che corrisponde a decilitri 3 circa' (No. 451); half a glass is therefore about 150 ml.
sourceNote.de: Das Buch nennt die Größe seines Glases in zwei anderen Rezepten: ‚un bicchiere ossia 3 decilitri‘ (Nr. 443) und ‚un bicchiere da tavola che corrisponde a decilitri 3 circa‘ (Nr. 451); ein halbes Glas sind demnach etwa 150 ml.

text.en: Boil the potatoes until a pointed stick passes freely from one side to the other.
text.de: Die Kartoffeln kochen, bis ein spitzes Hölzchen frei von einer Seite zur anderen durchgeht.

text.en: Pass them through a sieve while they are boiling hot.
text.de: Kochend heiß durch ein Sieb streichen.

text.en: Put them on the heat in a saucepan with the butter, the milk and the salt and work them well with a wooden spoon until they are fine.
text.de: Mit Butter, Milch und Salz in einem Topf auf den Herd stellen und mit dem Kochlöffel kräftig durcharbeiten, bis sie fein sind.

settled.reason: Our judgement: the source names no number of persons; 500 g of potatoes are taken as a side dish for four.

settled.value: milk, not cream: the source says either ('Latte buono, o panna')
settled.reason: The line needs one catalogue ingredient; milk stands first in the source. The amount itself is not settled: half a glass, with the glass of 3 decilitres as the book states it in No. 443 and No. 451 (see units).

check.note: Second agent session, 2026-11-23, not the transcriber. Page images of the 1891 scan (archive.org artusi-1891, text PDF) p. 198 compared: potatoes 500 g, 'Burro, grammi 50' (OCR 'Purro'), 'mezzo bicchiere', 'Sale quanto basta'. Glass read in print: No. 443 p. 330 'un bicchiere ossia 3 decilitri', No. 451 p. 335 'bicchiere da tavola ... decilitri 3 circa'. Corrected: unit bicchiere = 300 ml defined, milk 0.5 bicchiere; 'Purro' note removed. Not seen in print: No. 281.

note.en: The book gives this as a side dish, among others to cotechino and zampone. No time is given. The potato cake of No. 281 starts from the same preparation.
note.de: Das Buch gibt dies als Beilage an, unter anderem zu Cotechino und Zampone. Eine Zeit ist nicht angegeben. Der Kartoffelkuchen von Nr. 281 geht von derselben Zubereitung aus.
